# chargebee_item_family (Resource)

A Chargebee product family (Product Catalog 2.0). If a family with the given id already exists in Chargebee, it is adopted into state and its name and description are updated to match this configuration. Note: Chargebee cannot archive item families; if deletion is refused because the family is in use, the family is left in place with a warning and removed from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "chargebee_item_family" "main" {
  id          = "main"
  name        = "Main"
  description = "Primary product family"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the item family. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Display name of the item family.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the item family.

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) Status of the item family in Chargebee.
